name: Sons of the Mechanic
lore: Where flesh fails under the grind of endless war, the Legion of the Mechanic replaces it with chronal-forged iron. Their Primal Mechanic teaches that a warrior's true strength is measured in unbroken circuits and remorseless logic: every fallen brother rebuilt harder than before.

rules.name: Iron Calculus
rules.lore: The Sons of the Mechanic fight as a single machine: cold, precise, and unwilling to yield even a fraction of ground without extracting a toll in return.
rules.text: Each time a +Shattered Legions+ +Infantry+ unit from your army is selected as the target of an attack, until the end of that attack sequence models in that unit have !Feel No Pain 6+!. If the attacking unit is your army's Vow of Eternity target, that !Feel No Pain! is 5+ instead.

strategems.name: Cogwork Barrage
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, ranged weapons equipped by models in the target unit have +[Sustained Hits 1]+ and +[Heavy]+.

strategems.name: Refuse the Flesh
strategems.when: After an Activated enemy unit has completed its Shoot or Fight attacks
strategems.target: A +Shattered Legions+ unit that had one or more models destroyed by that attack
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, the target unit has !Feel No Pain 5+!.

strategems.name: Calculated Retribution
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, attacks made by the target unit against your Vow of Eternity target can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

spells.name: Machine Insight
spells.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, one friendly +Legion of the Mechanic+ unit within 18" of this +Psyker+ can re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

spells.name: Chronal Overclock
spells.effect: Select one friendly +Shattered Legions+ +Infantry+ unit within 12". Until the end of the Battle Round, that unit's =person-running= Movement is improved by 2" and its ranged weapons have +[Assault]+.

spells.name: Null Pulse
spells.effect: Select one enemy unit within 18". Until the end of the Battle Round, that unit cannot re-roll Hit rolls or Wound rolls.

upgrades.name: Forge-Born Scion
upgrades.text: At the start of the battle, gain 1 CP.

upgrades.name: Ironclad Frame
upgrades.text: Your +Warlord+ has !Feel No Pain 6+!. If it already had !Feel No Pain 6+!, it gains !Feel No Pain 5+! instead.

upgrades.name: Logic of Annihilation
upgrades.text: Ranged weapons equipped by your +Warlord+ (and by models in its attached unit, if any) have +1 to their =bullseye= Ballistic Skill trait.
